q: The Bowen-Manning formula expresses the Hausdorff dimension of the basic set Λ of a conformal Anosov diffeomorphism in terms of the pressure function P(·). Specifically:
opts: dim_H(Λ) = t_s + t_u where P(−t_s φ^s) = 0 and P(−t_u φ^u) = 0 (t_s and t_u are solutions to Bowen equations)
exp: For conformal Anosov maps, dim_H(Λ) = t_s + t_u where t_s (resp. t_u) solves the Bowen equation P(−t_s log|DT|_{E^s}|) = 0 (P = topological pressure). The formula decouples into stable and unstable contributions in the conformal case.
